summary: Targeted Dispatch attendance re-verification completed against the public preview URL. The requested 28-test backend regression passed 28/28, including Created/Deleted remarks:null contracts. All requested frontend flows passed: long-name create without ResizeObserver overlay, remarks-only Edited audit with field transition, no-op edit without PUT, Check-in/Checkout history and row updates, Confirm, Cancel, and Delete. One additional edit edge defect was found: clearing existing remarks sends remarks:null, but PUT ignores explicit null and records an empty Edited diff.

minor.issue: Explicit remarks:null does not clear existing remarks. The endpoint still returns 200, leaves the old value persisted, and appends an Edited history entry with old_value:{} and new_value:{} instead of a remarks transition. Reproduced with an isolated schedule.

integration_issues.flow: Clear schedule remarks in Edit dialog
integration_issues.issue: The frontend correctly converts an emptied remarks field to null, but the backend drops null values; therefore users cannot clear remarks and Action History shows an empty Edited audit.

action_items: Update ScheduleUpdate handling to distinguish omitted fields from explicitly supplied null values (for example, model_dump(exclude_unset=true)) so remarks and other nullable editable fields can be cleared and audited accurately.
Avoid creating an Edited action when the effective update contains no user-editable changes.
critical_code_review_comments: update_schedule builds upd by filtering every None value from payload.model_dump(), so it loses the distinction between an omitted field and an explicit null sent to clear a nullable field; the frontend intentionally sends null for cleared inputs.
update_schedule always recomputes duty_hours and logs Edited even when no meaningful editable key survives normalization, allowing empty old/new audit snapshots from direct API requests.

success_rate.backend: 96.6% overall (28/28 requested regression tests passed; 0/1 additional remarks-clearing edge test passed)

seed_data_creation: Backend suites and the UI flow created isolated TEST_ Dispatch references and schedules. Schedules were permanently deleted; reference entities were soft-deactivated during cleanup. The UI used four >25-character reference names and removed its schedule after Confirm/Cancel/Delete regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The three iteration_18 HIGH fixes are verified. Re-run test_dispatch_edit_clear_iter19.py after changing PUT null handling; expected result is remarks cleared to null and latest Edited history old_value.remarks=<original>, new_value.remarks=null. Requested 28-test suite is green.
rca_of_the_issue: DispatchSchedulePage submit converts a cleared text value to null as designed. In dispatch.py update_schedule, payload.model_dump() is filtered with if v is not None, which removes explicitly supplied remarks:null. The endpoint then adds only duty_hours and metadata, updates no remarks, and _log_action receives empty user snapshots, producing a misleading empty Edited entry.
